description: Propagate the merit-over-cost rule to the subagent-planner in both agent copies, closing the last gap in the think->build->gate->approve governance chain.

userStories.title: Add merit-over-cost rule to subagent-planner (both copies) and regen embedded vendor
userStories.description: As a cam maintainer, I need the merit-over-cost governance rule present in the subagent-planner instructions (both the .claude runtime copy and the templates adopter-facing copy), so that the agent that authors PRD scope and story decomposition cannot undersize, oversize, or weaken a story's design for cost or effort reasons, matching the rule CAM-379 already shipped to the implementer, reviewer, and auditor.
acceptanceCriteria: Insert the EXACT dictated bullet from the issue spec (starting '- **Merit over cost.**') at the end of the '## Story Sizing Rules' section, after the last 'Too big' split bullet and before the '## Story Ordering' heading, in .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'Merit over cost' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md]
Insert the same EXACT bullet at the same location in templates/agents/subagent-planner.md. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'Merit over cost' templates/agents/subagent-planner.md]
The .claude planner copy carries the verbatim context-window must-survive clause. [oracle: grep -q 'context-window exhaustion is a quality criterion' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md]
The templates planner copy carries the verbatim context-window must-survive clause. [oracle: grep -q 'context-window exhaustion is a quality criterion' templates/agents/subagent-planner.md]
The .claude planner copy carries the verbatim scope-limiter must-survive clause. [oracle: grep -q 'Simplicity remains the scope limiter' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md]
The templates planner copy carries the verbatim scope-limiter must-survive clause. [oracle: grep -q 'Simplicity remains the scope limiter' templates/agents/subagent-planner.md]
The .claude planner copy carries the dictated planner-role framing phrase. [oracle: grep -q 'undersize, oversize, or weaken' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md]
The templates planner copy carries the dictated planner-role framing phrase. [oracle: grep -q 'undersize, oversize, or weaken' templates/agents/subagent-planner.md]

The two planner copies remain byte-identical after the edit (no deliberate divergence, not reconciled into a shared file). [oracle: file-assert diff .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md templates/agents/subagent-planner.md]
The bullet appears inside the '## Story Sizing Rules' section and before the '## Story Ordering' heading (correct sizing surface, not elsewhere). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
The embedded vendor blob is regenerated to match templates/ (bun run embed-vendor) and the drift check passes. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
The embedded drift test is green. [oracle: bun test test/embedded.test.ts]

No other agent copy (implementer, reviewer, auditor, orchestrator) is modified by this story. [oracle: file-assert git diff --name-only main | grep -v 'subagent-planner\|_generated' | grep -q 'agents/' && exit 1 || exit 0]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
userStories.notes: Files: .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md and templates/agents/subagent-planner.md (currently byte-identical, 205 lines). Insert the dictated bullet verbatim after line ~131 (last 'Too big' split bullet) and before '## Story Ordering' (line ~135) in BOTH copies with IDENTICAL text. Copy the exact bullet from the issue spec.scope; the two must-survive clauses (A scope-limiter 'Simplicity remains the scope limiter' and B context-window 'context-window exhaustion is a quality criterion, not a cost one') must be verbatim, matching the CAM-379 versions already in .claude/agents/subagent-{implementer,reviewer,auditor}.md. Gotchas: (1) do NOT reword the two clauses; (2) do NOT introduce divergence between the two copies or reconcile them into a shared file; (3) do NOT touch the implementer/reviewer/auditor/orchestrator copies; (4) after editing the templates copy, run `bun run embed-vendor` to refresh src/vendor/_generated.ts, else embed-vendor:check fails CI. Pattern: 'Agent-prompt self-hosting pattern' (patterns.md) - templates/agents is source of truth, .claude/agents is runtime mirror, both edited then embed-vendor run; call out 'intentional self-hosting' in the commit so an auditor does not flag harness drift. The templatesContents byte-parity test in test/embedded.test.ts catches drift.
